_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-35 directional base rate, conflicting liquidity backdrop vs the bullish analog, and supply-constrained positioning extremes create a coin-flip coil where patience is the edge — name the breaker when it arrives.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD (coil, no breaker visible); narrative implies directional LONG (mean-reversion setup). The analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and its direct ownership of the 0% hit-rate data tilt consensus toward HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score breaks above 39 into Anxiety with rising fed_liquidity — validates risk-on rotation and triggers LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks below 31 into Panic on ETF flow reversal — kills the accumulation thesis and triggers REDUCE
